messages:
Taylor: Hey folks — clearing out some desk gear before the move. Free 34" ultrawide (3440x1440, 100Hz) in excellent shape. Also have 2x GA tickets to The Sunders show this Sat (can split if needed). Pickup SF office (4th floor) anytime before Monday. Pics: https://imgur.com/example1 :sparkles:
Ravi: Interested in the monitor! Is it VESA mountable? Any dead pixels?
Taylor: Yep VESA 100. No dead pixels, comes with original stand, HDMI + DP cables. Light scuff on the bottom bezel.
Priya: Ooh the tickets! Anyone want to trade for a monitor arm? I have a single-arm desk mount that I can swap.
Sam: I can take the second ticket if Priya wants to trade. What time's the show?
Taylor: Show starts 8pm. Tickets are e-tix (can transfer). Happy to split monitor/tix separately.
Priya: Trade sounds good, @Taylor can we DM to arrange swap? I can bring arm + tools.
Taylor: Yes please DM. If the monitor isn't claimed by Friday I'll post here again.
Ravi: Can I reserve the monitor? I can pick up Monday morning. Leaving a note here so others know.
Sam: Confirmed for ticket 2. DM sent. Thanks! :raised_hands:
OfficeBot: :warning: Reminder: personal items left in common areas should be labeled with owner and pick-up deadline. Unclaimed items may be donated to the office swap shelf after 72 hours.
Taylor: Will label with my name + contact. Also have a small standing desk riser (IKEA Bekant converter) — $30 or trade for a comfy desk chair.
Ravi: FYI @Taylor, the Bekant converter often needs the clamp tightened; I can bring a wrench when I pick up.
Taylor: Thanks, appreciated. If anyone wants the riser, first to DM gets it.
Priya: Quick Q — does the monitor support USB-C power delivery? I use a MacBook and prefer single-cable if possible.
Taylor: No USB-C display/power, just DP + HDMI. Mac works via DP adapter.
Sam: Congrats on the move! Hope the new place has better kitchen vibes :partyparrot:
Taylor: Thanks! If anything left after Monday I'll drop the monitor on the swap shelf and the tickets go to anyone who asked first. Cheers everyone.
